text: In the leaky-integrator ESN used in these labs, which weights are adapted during training?
choices: W_rec and W_in are trained by backpropagation through time; W_out is left fixed
All three of W_rec, W_in, and W_out are optimized jointly
Only the readout W_out, via ridge regression; W_rec, W_in, and the bias b stay fixed random matrices
Only W_rec, which is rescaled every epoch to keep the spectral radius below 1
explanation: The defining feature of reservoir computing is that only the linear readout W_out is trained (here by ridge regression, W_out = Y X^T (X X^T + lambda I)^-1). W_rec, W_in and b are drawn randomly once and never updated, so options mentioning backprop or joint training of the recurrent/input weights describe conventional RNN training, not an ESN. W_rec is rescaled once at construction (not per epoch) and is not a trainable parameter.
